description: Rich 2026-10-04T1026Z chose '1 and 3' (relayed by Codex): test Carbonate availability together with modest population-supply and evolution-pacing levers, separately and in small combinations with L3 (fewer early job slots). At most eight candidate runs; two controls and the L3 anchor are re-run in the same harness. Candidate only. Repair Enzyme relief is NOT a lever; unpaid upkeep stays a failure metric.

L3.why: Fewer early job slots (workforce_scale_v1 level L3): outputs unchanged, crews of 3-4 lose one slot.

C.why: Carbonate precipitates slowly in the calcifying shallows, so surface Carbonate renews like the Anoxic Basin does (existing renewal_per_minute mechanic). 0.2/min is below the gleaners' full-crew yield, so it slows exhaustion instead of gifting stock.

P.why: Modest population supply: migration 0.5 -> 0.75 per minute (+50%; the value tested in governor sweep v2). Needs Growth Nutrient and free housing as before.

E.why: Modest evolution cost: a Stable home needs 1 Growth Nutrient instead of 2 (services and the 90 s sustain are unchanged).
